incident: An independent reviewer mistakenly launched a second copy of verify.py against the same output directory.
disposition: Original main-run results report success but the overwritten Cargo logs are incomplete and are not accepted as final evidence. Post-fix reruns in a fresh directory are authoritative.
source_evidence: Root directly compared all 124 file snapshots (the initial index additionally records two deleted source paths) with current source bytes before applying the final formatting/test-support path changes; no mismatch.
recovery: Reviewer terminated the duplicate process group and root observed no remaining matrix processes before starting post-fix. Replay now requires a fresh output directory.
retained_evidence: All initial logs and results remain preserved; no prior failure output was overwritten by the repair.
